metadata.title: Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One
metadata.thing: the packet-electron collision at the escape cost
metadata.palette_note: Bear's call (2026-07-03, after viewing): literal RED for the low-frequency light — #FC6255 (3b1b-style red, reads on the dark canvas), overriding the series no-red rule for this video only. High-frequency stays blue #58C4DD. The layout audit checks geometry only, so this is safe.
metadata.long_title: Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One — in about a minute | Bear's Notes
metadata.short_title: Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One #Shorts
metadata.description_blurb: The photoelectric effect in about a minute: light as packets whose energy is set by color, an all-or-nothing escape cost, and why color — not brightness — decides. The full explainer (leftover energy, threshold frequency, sodium by the numbers) is on the channel.
metadata.short_blurb: The photoelectric effect, in about a minute. Full explainer on the channel.

beats.narration_text:
Bear's Notes

Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One
beats.tts_normalized_text:
Bear's Notes.

Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One.
beats.new_visual_element: Title card: 'Bear's Notes' small, title large in EB Garamond, thin brown rule, small blue accent mark on dark canvas.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Fade in series line, Write the title, brown underline, blue tick. Hold.

beats.narration_text: Aim the brightest red lamp you own at a metal plate — and not one electron escapes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Aim the brightest red lamp you own at a metal plate — and not one electron escapes.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Metal plate with blue electron dots; warm amber lamp pours long lazy waves onto it; label 'red'. Nothing moves.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create plate + electrons; grow warm lamp; long-wavelength waves flow in. Electrons still.

beats.narration_text: Swap in a dim blue glow, and electrons fly off instantly.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Swap in a dim blue glow, and electrons fly off instantly.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Lamp morphs to small dim blue; waves tighten; two electrons leap off at once; label 'blue'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform lamp and waves; electrons fly off along arcs immediately.

beats.narration_text: Crank the red to blinding and still — nothing.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Crank the red to blinding and still — nothing.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Warm lamp returns huge and bright, waves multiply, '×100' appears; electrons stone still.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform back to big warm lamp; triple the waves; ×100 pops in; nothing moves.

beats.narration_text: So stop picturing a smooth wave: light arrives as separate packets.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So stop picturing a smooth wave: light arrives as separate packets.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A smooth wave draws, then breaks into a marching stream of discrete packets.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create smooth wave; Transform into evenly spaced packet dots drifting rightward.

beats.narration_text: Each packet's energy is set only by its color — red packets weak, blue packets strong.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each packet's energy is set only by its color — red packets weak, blue packets strong.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] One warm and one blue packet, each above an energy bar: short warm, tall blue; labels 'red · weak', 'blue · strong'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Two packets enlarge from the stream; bars grow to different heights; labels write.

beats.narration_text: Brightness just means more packets per second, never fatter ones.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Brightness just means more packets per second, never fatter ones.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The warm stream densifies; the warm energy bar stays the same height and flashes highlight once.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Multiply warm packets; Indicate the unchanged bar with highlight.

beats.narration_text: And an electron breaks free only if one single packet pays its whole escape cost at once.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And an electron breaks free only if one single packet pays its whole escape cost at once.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Comparison parks; a U-well appears with a blue electron at the bottom and a dashed rim hairline labeled 'escape cost'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Packets shrink aside; Create well; electron drops in; rim + label write.

beats.narration_text: Every red packet falls short — a flood of near-misses frees nothing.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Every red packet falls short — a flood of near-misses frees nothing.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] Warm packets rain in; the electron hops to the same sub-rim height each time and falls back; corner counter 'freed: 0'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Lagged warm packets; electron bobs below the rim repeatedly; counter stays 0.

beats.narration_text: One faint blue packet clears the cost in a single hit, and the electron flies.
beats.tts_normalized_text: One faint blue packet clears the cost in a single hit, and the electron flies.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] A single blue packet arrives; the electron shoots over the rim in one motion and arcs away; counter ticks to 1.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Blue packet in; electron rises past rim continuously, escapes; counter 0→1.

beats.narration_text: That's E equals h nu: color is energy, and the packet is called a photon.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That's E equals h nu: color is energy, and the packet is called a photon.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] E = hν writes above the lab; 'photon' fades in beneath — the name as endpoint.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write MathTex E = h\nu; 'photon' fades in under it.

beats.narration_text: Brightness counts the packets; color decides whether any one of them can pay.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Brightness counts the packets; color decides whether any one of them can pay.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] The two hook lamps return above the well: warm torrent — every hop dies below the rim; blue trickle — each packet lofts an electron out.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn both lamps; run both streams; warm fails en masse, blue frees one; brief hold.

beats.narration_text: The full story — the leftover energy, the threshold color, the sodium numbers — is in the long video. Thanks for watching — more at youtube dot com, slash, at Nik Bear Brown.
